cat > auto.py <<'PY'
import arena,subprocess,chess,sys,time
for i in range(int(sys.argv[1])):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 h=chess.Board()
 with open('history.fen','w') as f:
  f.write(h.fen()+'\n')
  for m in b.move_stack:
   h.push(m);f.write(h.fen()+'\n')
 out=subprocess.check_output(['./thinker',b.fen(),sys.argv[2],'history.fen'],text=True)
 with open('autolog.txt','a') as f:f.write(b.fen()+'\n'+out+'\n')
 last=out.strip().splitlines()[-1]
 print(last,flush=True)
 m=last.split()[1]
 if chess.Move.from_uci(m) not in b.legal_moves:raise RuntimeError(m)
 arena.cmd_move(m)
 sys.stdout.flush()
